exposure: amniotic fluid volume (AFV) measured by amniotic fluid index (AFI)
low AFV by color Doppler sonography
amniotic fluid volume (AFV) measured by single deepest pocket (SDP)
cohort: 428 women admitted to labor and delivery with the anticipation of a vaginal delivery.
finding: The use of color Doppler sonography leads to the overdiagnosis of low AFVs and does not appear to increase the detection of pregnancies destined for adverse intrapartum or perinatal outcomes.
